worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.summary: Turn and whip your tail in a full ring around you, dazing every foe that can see it and lowering their Defense. Because it circles you, it catches enemies behind you too; the tail must be seen, so cover blocks it.
worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.use.0: Break the guard of a whole ring when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.use.1: Open a gap for an ally's physical attacks
worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.use.2: Clip the enemies that slipped around behind you
worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.description.0: Foes caught by the tail lose %1$s Defense stage(s) and stay dazed for %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.description.1: Tail radius %1$s catches every visible non-friendly inside it, whipping out %2$s trails. Line of sight is required; cover blocks it.
worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.description.2: Windup %1$s with a %2$s cooldown. A full ring around you, so enemies behind are swept too.
worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.preference.ai: The companion only steps in to whip while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it at point-blank, larger approaches on its own.
The companion only whips when at least this many visible, not-yet-broken non-friendly bodies are inside the ring, so the windup is not wasted; 1 means whip whenever it sees one.
When on, the companion may leave its post to whip its tail under a Hold order.
